clean_story:
Now I will teach you Memories. Memories are like footprints in your mind, left by things you have seen, felt, or done. Just as you remember where the best berries grow, memories help you recall past events. They are like the smoke from a fire, lingering even after the flames have died. You can close your eyes and see the mammoth you hunted last moon. You can feel the warmth of the sun on your skin from many suns ago.

This is Memories.
